title: Apply 5 targeted fixes to Leave Application Generator

requirements.text: Add back the 'Parent / Guardian Name' input field in the Leave Application form. Place it on the same row as 'Student Name', to the right of it, each field taking 50% width. Apply the same styling and required validation as 'Student Name'. The row must render as: [ Student Name ] [ Parent / Guardian Name ].

quotes: Add it back. Place it: On the SAME ROW as 'Student Name' - On the RIGHT side of 'Student Name' - Maintain same width and styling - Keep required validation same as before

acceptanceCriteria: Parent / Guardian Name field is visible in the form
It appears to the right of Student Name on the same row
Both fields share equal width (50% each)
Field is required and shows validation error if left empty on submit
Styling matches the Student Name field exactly

requirements.text: Move the 'Class / Grade' field so it appears to the right of 'School / Institution Name' (not beside Student Name). The final two-row layout must be: Row 1: [ Student Name ] [ Parent / Guardian Name ]; Row 2: [ School / Institution Name ] [ Class / Grade ]. Do not change field styling.

quotes: Move 'Class / Grade' field: To the RIGHT side of 'School / Institution Name'

acceptanceCriteria: Class / Grade no longer appears beside Student Name
Class / Grade appears to the right of School / Institution Name on the same row
Row 1 shows Student Name and Parent / Guardian Name
Row 2 shows School / Institution Name and Class / Grade
No styling changes applied to either field

requirements.text: Move the Language dropdown from its current bottom position to the same row as 'Recipient Type'. Reduce Recipient Type to 50% width and place Language on the right at 50% width. Maintain all existing dropdown functionality and styling for both fields.

quotes: Move it: On the SAME ROW as 'Recipient Type' - Reduce Recipient Type width slightly (50%) - Place Language on right side (50%)

acceptanceCriteria: Language dropdown no longer appears at the bottom of the form
Language dropdown is on the same row as Recipient Type
Recipient Type takes 50% width, Language takes 50% width
All language options remain functional
Existing dropdown styling is unchanged

requirements.text: Add a 'Clear' button to the output section of the Leave Application page. The final button order must be: Copy | Download TXT | Download PDF | Clear. The Clear button must clear the preview/output content only — it must not reload the page, navigate away, or affect any input fields.

quotes: Add back: Clear button. Final Button Order: Copy | Download TXT | Download PDF | Clear. Clear button must: Clear preview content - Not refresh page - Not affect input fields

acceptanceCriteria: Clear button is present in the output section after Download PDF
Clicking Clear removes the generated letter preview text
Page does not reload when Clear is clicked
All input fields retain their values after clicking Clear
Copy, Download TXT, and Download PDF buttons are still present and functional

requirements.text: Fix the Download PDF button in the Leave Application output section to prevent page freezing. Use an async handler with event.preventDefault() and try/catch error handling. Disable the button immediately on click to prevent multiple rapid clicks, show a brief loading indicator (e.g., 'Generating…' label) during generation, and re-enable the button after completion or on error. Ensure no blocking synchronous operations and no infinite loops. The page must remain responsive throughout PDF generation.

quotes: Fix requirements: Single click should generate PDF - Prevent multiple rapid clicks - Disable button during generation - Re-enable after completion - No page reload - No UI freeze - Use async/await properly - Handle errors with try/catch - Show small loading state while generating

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking Download PDF does not freeze or lock the page
PDF is generated and downloaded on a single click
Button is disabled immediately upon click and re-enabled after completion or error
A loading state (e.g., 'Generating…') is shown on the button while PDF is being created
Multiple rapid clicks do not trigger multiple PDF generations
Errors during PDF generation are caught and the button is re-enabled
No page reload occurs during or after PDF generation

constraints: Do NOT change the design theme or any styling
Do NOT modify Leave Duration Type field
Do NOT touch Absent Since Date field
Do NOT modify output spacing or alignment
Do NOT modify any other feature outside the 5 listed fixes
Do NOT redesign the layout beyond the specific field repositioning described
nonGoals: Redesigning the Leave Application page layout
Adding new features or fields beyond Parent / Guardian Name
Changing any styling, colors, or typography
Modifying any other page in the application
